comment: `publicBaseUrl` is the base the app fetches bundles from and the base the
contact sheet links thumbnails at. It is public by definition — it appears in
every request a visitor's browser makes — so it is committed here rather than
hidden in an environment variable, which also means a batch run needs no
per-shell setup to produce correct URLs.
It is still *configuration*, never a constant in pipeline or app source: the
r2.dev development URL below is expected to be replaced by a custom domain,
and that must be a one-line edit here plus a rebuild of the app with
R2_BUCKET) are NOT here and never will be — they come from the environment
only. R2_PUBLIC_BASE_URL in the environment still wins over this file.
